_about: PROPOSAL (Sal, 2026-10-31), read by nothing yet. Starter goals for the first island, taken from TUTORIAL_FIRST_30_MIN.md (the guide's text is the source of truth for hint wording). Format for a coder: `goals` is an ordered list; each goal has `id`, `title`, `hint` (plain text shown in the goal list), `after` (goal ids that must be done first; empty = available at start), `check` (one of: {event, count, what?} fired by the server when the thing happens, {have_item, count} true while the pack holds that many, {made_item, count} counted when a craft finishes, {have_item_any, count}), and `reward` ({coin_copper: n} through the purse, or {item: [id, n]} given to the pack; both small on purpose). A goal completes once and is saved per character (characters.json `goals_done`). Events to emit in server_items.gd: drink, tree_felled, fire_lit, ate_food, placed(what), carcass_worked. Rewards total about 70 copper plus a few sticks and kindling.

goals.title: Drink at the water
goals.hint: Walk to the water's edge and press E to drink.

goals.title: Gather plant fibre
goals.hint: Nettles and tall grass give plant fibre. Press E on a plant.

goals.title: Twist twine
goals.hint: Open the inventory (I), pick Twine and craft it: 3 plant fibre make 1 twine.

goals.title: Make a stone axe
goals.hint: 1 stone, 1 stick and 2 twine make a stone axe. Put it on the hotbar to use it.

goals.title: Fell a tree
goals.hint: Hold the axe and strike a tree again and again. Then work the trunk for logs.

goals.title: Light a fire
goals.hint: Make a Campfire kit (6 sticks, 3 stones), place it, then press E near it with plant fibre to light it.

goals.title: Eat something wild
goals.hint: Pick berries or nuts with E. Hold E at the fire to roast them, then eat.

goals.title: Build a lean-to
goals.hint: 8 sticks, 6 leaves, 2 twine make a Small shelter. Place it with the open side towards you.

goals.title: Make a bed
goals.hint: Gather bedding from ferns or thatch from grass, then craft a Rough bed and place it under cover.

goals.title: Build a workbench
goals.hint: 20 sticks, 6 twine and 4 stones make a Workbench. It unlocks better tools.

goals.title: Make a spear
goals.hint: A wooden spear (1 stick, keep a stone) then 2 twine for a stone spear.

goals.title: Make a stone knife and work a kill
goals.hint: 2 stones and a stick make a knife. Strike a rabbit with the spear, then work the body with the knife.

goals.title: Catch a fish
goals.hint: Make a fishing rod (or a shore net) and fish at the pond.
